opening.argument: The presentation centers on a defined online education program, not a guaranteed employment outcome. It identifies a Google IT Support certificate offered through Coursera, states that “The duration of the program is 8 months” and that it includes six courses, and directs viewers to ordinary enrollment. Access terms are presented openly: students receive “a seven-day free trial” followed by payment, with the option to cancel before the trial ends. The stated benefit is preparation for entry-level work, not a promised job; the narration says the program will “prepare. Students for the entry-level IT jobs which don't require any degree.” Completion produces a certificate, while the viewer is expected to update qualifications and pursue employment independently. The sign-up and payment details therefore describe standard course access rather than a deceptive promise of guaranteed results.
